CONCLUSIONS

The
result
of
the
sewage
pollution
produced
by
the
Monterey
sewage
treatment

plant
is
an
enrichment
of
the
populations
of
interstitial
organisms
to
the

south
of
the
outfall
where
a
large
amount
of
the
sewage
appears
to
be
moving .

The
sewage
could
be
enriching
the
beach
environment
directly

providing

readily

basic
nutrients

bacteria ,

a

constant

of
bacteria
( live
or
dead )
